reasoning_traces.think:
The settlement system operates under a dual-path architecture governed by key validity. The free path (ESPN/henrygd) is the default and primary mechanism, activated every cycle since 2026-09-02. A paid supplement (Odds API) is conditionally appended only if the key is both present and valid. This creates a binary decision tree: if key is valid, run free + supplement; otherwise, run free only. Failure modes include key deactivation, which triggers a silent fail in supplement but preserves free grading. Disputes arise from ESPN/henrygd disagreement, leading to DISPUTED holds. Stale backfill handles unresolved picks after 6 hours, ensuring no outcome remains pending indefinitely. The system enforces path selection through URL parameter (?path=free) or internal logic, preventing misclassification of paths. The telemetry captures these states via Sentry and response labels, enabling retroactive analysis and alerting.
